en: A vintage monochrome postcard view of a river scene with traditional sailboats (likely feluccas) passing through an open metal bridge. The bridge's central span is rotated open to allow river traffic. People stand along the riverbank and on the bridge. The watermarked website 'www.elia.org.gr' is superimposed on the image, and printed caption text at the bottom reads "CAIRO. - The Kasr-el-Nil Bridge open."
